assumptions.text: Small software teams spend too much time writing release notes and changelogs.
developers and product managers at small SaaS companies have this problem.
This solves it: A web app that drafts customer-facing release notes from a small software team's merged pull requests, for a person to edit and publish.
These customers can be reached in: English-speaking small SaaS companies, online.
The founder can build and test it with: Python and web development, technical writing; 10 hours a week; 300 EUR.
Enough of these customers would pay for it.
